caption: Last onboarding step: the phone number field is optional and was left empty; only role and 'How did you hear about us?' are required.
After onboarding: 'Your Growth Plan trial ends in 7 days on Nov 07, 2026' and a welcome offering 7 days of full Growth access, with no card asked for; the account name is hidden.
CSV import instructions say an email, a phone number or a contact ID can identify existing contacts.
Import mapping offers only standard fields: Phone Number (marked identifier), First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Assignee and Lifecycle.
With email mapped to Email Address the import still stops on 'Identifier - Phone Number must be mapped.'
The two test contacts, added by hand, selected: the more-actions menu offers Export to CSV.
Monthly plan page: Starter $99, Growth $199 (current trial) and Advanced $349 a month.
Choosing Starter lists the Growth features you would lose, such as AI Agents, Workflows and the Developer API; Billed Now shows USD $99.00 a month.
